scenes.headline: A LIGHTER CONTAINER RUNTIME
scenes.depicts: Your containers could launch without Docker Desktop. Meet Kiri.

scenes.headline: KEEP YOUR WORKFLOW
scenes.depicts: Kiri runs your Docker images and works with the Docker commands and Compose you already use.

scenes.headline: ONE TEST, TWO RESULTS
scenes.depicts: In Kiri’s own test, starting and removing a tiny container took two point five five milliseconds, versus two hundred thirteen for Docker Desktop.

scenes.headline: READ THE FINE PRINT
scenes.depicts: That is a median of thirty runs through the Docker API, not a guarantee for every app.

scenes.headline: WORKS ACROSS PLATFORMS
scenes.depicts: It supports Mac, Linux and Windows. On Windows it requires W S L two.
